# Navigation Menu

Combine native links and expandable navigation panels in one bar.

## Usage

### Product

Combine native product links with disclosure triggers in one navigation surface.

## Active-item motion example

Use each Navigation Menu item `data-state="open|closed"` to move an underline or indicator without shifting the surrounding navigation layout.

```css
[data-scope='navigation-menu'][data-part='item'] {
  position: relative;
}

[data-scope='navigation-menu'][data-part='item']::after {
  position: absolute;
  inset-inline: 0;
  inset-block-end: -0.25rem;
  block-size: 2px;
  content: '';
  background: currentColor;
  transform: scaleX(0);
  transform-origin: center;
  transition: transform 160ms ease;
}

[data-scope='navigation-menu'][data-part='item'][data-state='open']::after {
  transform: scaleX(1);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  [data-scope='navigation-menu'][data-part='item']::after {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```

## Accessibility

Native links keep link semantics while disclosure triggers expose expanded state for compound panels.

See the [corresponding WAI-ARIA pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/disclosure/examples/disclosure-navigation/) for the host accessibility contract.
